title: Relative flatness on one affine chart
statement: Let $X,S$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] with $S$ affine, $f:X\to S$ a morphism, $G$ a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], and $U$ an affine open of $X$. Give $\Gamma(U,G)$ its $\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$-action through $f^\sharp$. Then this section module is flat over $\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$ if and only if, for every $x\in U$, the actual module stalk $G_x$ [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], restricted along $f_x^\sharp$, is flat over $\mathcal O_{S,f(x)}$. No covering, finite presentation, or nonemptiness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Morphisms, lemma-flat-module; Algebra Tag 00HT, lemma-flat-localization, parts (2), (6), (7)

proof.text: Put R=O(S), C=O(U), N=G(U). For x in U, use the affine stalk tensor presentation to identify G_x with O_{X,x} tensor_C N. The identity appLE on U is the identity, so the section action agrees with the ordinary C-action. The stalk ring is C localized at the prime of x. Thus the composite of the tensor-unit map with this equivalence is an IsLocalizedModule map.

If N is R-flat, localization in C preserves R-flatness. The uniqueness equivalence between the explicit localized module and G_x transports this flatness. Germ-stalkMap compatibility identifies the R-action on G_x with restriction through O_{S,f(x)}. This base stalk is a localization of R; Module.flat_iff_of_isLocalization gives flatness over the base stalk.

Conversely choose, for each maximal ideal of C, its point x in U. The same tensor comparison gives an IsLocalizedModule map to G_x. The hypothesis makes G_x flat over the base stalk, which is itself R-flat by localization. Transitivity gives R-flatness of each of these localized C-modules. Apply Module.flat_of_isLocalized_maximal to recover R-flatness of N. The scalar tower is verified explicitly by f.germ_stalkMap_apply and germ_res_apply.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_chart_relative_flat_iff {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) (G : X.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (letI : Module Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(G, U.1) :=
      Module.compHom _ (f.appLE ⊤ U.1 (by simp)).hom
     Module.Flat Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(G, U.1)) ↔
    (∀ x : X, x ∈ U.1 → Module.Flat (S.presheaf.stalk (f x))
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (f.stalkMap x).hom).obj
        ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj G)))
